reviews.text:
Within an hour of reaching out to Ernie’s Plumbing I had a knock at my door!!! Gary Blakely was sent to provide an estimate to replace my irrigation double check valve. The estimate was fair and reasonable so he scheduled me for first thing the next day!! He arrived on time and did an amazing job well within the estimated time.

I would highly recommend Ernie’s Plumbing and especially Gary Blakely for your plumbing needs!!!

Before and after photos provided

Mike was polite, professional and courteous. He told me exactly what would happen and how long it would take to replace my water heater. I was very pleased with the service. I will do business with Ernie’s again.

" Buyer Beware!! "
We had Ernie's Plumbing do  scan of the sewage pipes because of a recurring clog.
After the video scan that gave use the estimate here attached.
It was VERY expensive (as you can see) so I asked for a copy of the video we paid for and they said "we do not supply copies of our scans."
That was an immediate red flag!
I called another plumbing company (LD Plumbing) and they said they could do a scan of the system and would provide a video with an explanation of what was found.
Th

OMG! My experience with Ernie’s Plumbing was prompt, professional and done with accuracy. Robert the Technician, was friendly but all business. He explained what needed to be done and then told me ‘why.’ I loved the facts and his sense of confidence. He did what he said and after a week of NO HOT WATER…I will be fired up for the holidays. Big Thanks to Robert and Ernie’s for stepping in and delivering Top Tier Plumbing Service. I will recommend them to any and everyone 👌👍🏽👏. A loyal customer for

Austin was knowledgeable, professional, and made excellent recommendations for my bath and kitchen. I originally called to replace the disposal, and ended up also replacing the kitchen and bath faucets plus shower head. I am so pleased with the results. I highly recommend Ernie’s Plumbing, they have lifetime customer with me.

I am a very  satisfied customer of Ernie’s Plumbing. It is my pleasure to post about Technician’s Robert and Sam.

They are customer satisfaction oriented with the best service. I have used Ernie’s over the past several years and will not hire anyone else to do the work needed in my home.

The great thing is the fact that employee turnover is almost non existent, so when I request service the technician’s have been to my home prior.

I have heard that Ernie’s plumbing is expensive, in my book co

Sam R came out today,  and on time! He quickly diagnosed the problem with one of our toilets. He offered helpful suggestions. While he was here, I asked him to check another toilet that had been acting oddly. He fixed both toilets. He’s an Extremely Nice Guy & obviously knows his trade thoroughly! Would highly recommend him & Ernie’s Plumbing time and again!  We’ve used this company (unfortunately) many times!  We’ve always been very pleased with their services!  And especially Sam!  Thank you f

Michael, Josh,  paul
They were all amazing. What I thought was a foundation issue wasn’t. It  was something far less expensive and was repaired that same day. Although a lot of digging had to happen, they took real good care of the area where they worked. I thought they were going to have to dig up part of my flower bed  thank goodness they didn’t . Worked non stop til completed. Excellent job you guys
The way they put my grass back together was amazing. 👍

Gary 483, I really appreciate him coming out asap. He explain everything  in layman's term as to what he was doing at the time. Gary is has done plumbing for years, very knowledgeable and honest. This is the second time we've had Gary do work for up and both times we were satisfiedwith his work. He is exceptional. Yes, I would recommend him for your plumbing needs.

Ernie's did great work for me. Austin is smart and experienced and knew instantly what my problem was. Advised us to buy a new faucet because the old one was worn out and down to a trickle of water coming out. We bought a new faucet and he came back out on short notice and installed it. He also went beyond the scope of his quote and re-worked the pvc to the disposal. He cleaned up after himself and charged me the low side of the estimate. It seems to us that its a lot harder to find a qualified

When we bought our house, we were told there was a small leak in the plumbing. My neighbor recommended Ernie’s plumbing. So I called at 1030 on Monday morning. They had a technician out here that afternoon. Turns out we needed some major repairs. We had pipes that were clogged, glued improperly, and all the water from our kitchen sink, dishwasher, and washing machine was just pouring out under the house. After inspecting as much as he could without getting soaked, Hershel explained everything th

David and Jonathan did fabulous work. Our water heater died and leaked into the house. They removed the old unit, patiently worked with us on scheduling for 2 weeks while we handled insurance and restoration, then installed the new unit perfectly. Very happy I contacted Ernie’s to handle this job, and I will definitely call again for future plumbing needs.

Sam Reinmiller arrived promptly. Introduced himself and we discussed the plumbing issue. Sam assessed the best way to resolve the issue and provided a fair, reasonable cost for repair. Sam successfully removed whatever was causing the drain to be clogged. Sam cleaned up the work area, collected payment and went to his next stop. Sam was courteous, polite and professional.  Super job Sam! Thanks!
I’ve been a customer of Ernie’s plumbing for about 20 years and have always had ‘gold standard’ repai

Robert showed up shortly after the call was made. He was professional,  knowledgeable and expedient. The price was reasonable to boot!
5 stars. I will definitely contact Ernie's for future plumbing needs.

I just used Ernie’s for the first time and am very happy with them. Greg did a great job and gave me detailed information on what he was doing to fix my issue.  He helped me with several other questions I had about other plumbing concerns in my house and was very nice and informative. I will be using them again. Thanks again Greg!

Horrible Experience!  Don't do it, over priced rip off!
It started with just trying to set up the appointment. The lady was rude and had poor communication. this should have been my first clue to not to use this company. But needed this repair fixed so went ahead with their 4 hour time span (which is ridiculous and told me if they send someone out they will only stay 10 minutes and leave. Then sends a text this morning saying if I don't answer the call when they call they won't dispatch their pl

Michael provided us with excellent service. He was upfront in the estimate process, asked great questions, and then was thorough with his repair. Would feel confident giving them a call for any future needs we may have!

We have always had good experiences with Ernie's Plumbing and today was no different. Our technician Scott Reddick was extremely knowledgeable, courteous, and fast. One thing I have always loved about Ernie's Plumbing is that the technicians will always offer alternatives and workarounds that will save money - they NEVER try and upsell or inflate costs/labor.

Robert was very helpful in getting our old leaking toilet replaced and helping me select a bidet to help me with my disabled mom's  health issues.. New toilet flushes much better with his added modifications.  Robert very friendly and helpful! Will use for more future repairs.

When the need came for a plumber, I took a chance and called Ernie’s Plumbing based on positive reviews.
After securing their business number, with fingers crossed, I called Ernie’s Plumbing.  I was greeted with a warm reception when speaking with a live person to check availability and pricing. After securing an appointment, I was told it would be a couple of hours before a a plumber arrived. To my surprise, Gene Gentry showed up earlier than anticipated. He entered my home, with footies in tow

I called Ernie’s to get an estimate for a new water heater. Josh arrived within a very short time and gave me several options with detailed explanations to bring my decades old installation up to code. After picking up my choice of heater (Rheem), he completed a rather extensive installation in just a few hours. I could not be happier with Josh and with the results of his labor. He is friendly, efficient, and extremely knowledgeable about his trade. I will be using Ernie’s and Josh for all my pl

Mr. Greg was amazing! He was extremely knowledgeable and thorough with his work and what needed to be done. He was patient with my questions and extremely professional. I am truly grateful for Mr. Greg who has worked for Ernie’s plumbing for 20 years. Great company experience from calling in for assistance with an appointment to the follow the next day to assure everything was completed satisfactory.

Auden Navarrette from Ernie’s Plumbing gets all the stars! He was prompt, friendly, courteous, went above-and-beyond to communicate exactly what he was doing (going so far as to give updates while he was off-site getting the new hot water heater) and fixed our issue. If you need a great plumber call Ernie’s - and ask for Auden - although I would bet everyone who works there is top tier.

Very impress with how quick and professional Ernie’s plumbing were with us today!
Had a massive issue with a leaky faucet that wouldn’t stop and forced us to shut down our water supply to the home.
Robert came out and was professional, polite and very knowledgeable.
Genuinely saved the day and highly recommended!
Gary 483 did an amazing job. He was very thorough and explained everything in terms we can understand. Any future issues come up and Gary will definitely be requested again.

Very quick service from dispatch to the plumber showing up. Scott was very nice, very courteous and explained my issues, what could be causing them and possible solutions. I got several options and once I decided what I’d like to have done Scott took care of the issue in a flash. Would absolutely recommend.

We had a toilet stop refilling after a flush on a Friday evening.  I was scheduled for a colonoscopy Tuesday so I really needed the toilet fixed.  My wife called Ernie’s Plumbing and left word.  They were at our house and quickly fixed the issue Monday morning.  Fantastic service!!  We have used Ernie’s Plumbing for years and this is why.  Their service people are professional and knowledgeable.  We are always pleased with their service

We had a great experience with Ernie's Plumbing. Set an appointment fast, Josh identified the problem quickly, and a new instillation was done at my house the next business day. Everyone was friendly and professional from the first call to the follow up call. Josh explained everything well, and I didn't feel like I was being sold something I didn't need. I will call them again when I need a plumber!

All I can say is if you need a plumber, this company is the one to call. Greg and Austin have been our go to guys for a long time now. Professional and nice. They take pride in their work. Hope you never have plumbing issues but if you do Ernie's, is the smart choice. 10 out of 10

Kitchen sink backed up. Ernie’s plumbing was able to come out quickly with a free estimate. Great price. Michael J was our technician. Super professional, knowledgeable and was happy to explain and even draw out what he was talking about to help me better understand. He got right to work and had my kitchen sink backed up and running within no time at all. Ernie’s for the win! I’ll definitely be calling on them if needed in the future.

Gary was very nice and knowledgeable. He showed up on time and fixed our backed up sewer drain in a timely manner. I would recommend Ernies plumbing to my neighbors for the trustworthy service I received.

Sam was awesome! He was professional, kind, explained everything to me in a way I could understand and gave me a fair price. I felt completely comfortable with him and he did an expert job with our issue. He came out that same day and gave me a call before arriving. I will definitely use Ernie’s plumbing again and ask for Sam! Thank you!

We needed a last minute water heater installed on the weekend and Ernie's Plumbing really stepped up. Sam worked extremely hard to get the job done, was very thorough and made sure everything worked. We really appreciated the fast and friendly service.

Sam with Ernie’s plumbing was great, friendly, knowledgeable, and speedy. I’ll call him out next time for sure.
As a woman at home alone or with her young children it can be intimidating having a stranger come work on your house but Sam was very professional and made me feel comfortable. Thanks Sam!

Our toilet in the master bath was leaking at the base and also our small bath wasn’t flushing properly! My husband called Ernie’s plumbing this morning and they sent out Anthony DeLee. He was here promptly and was very professional! He cleaned the  floor area and explained what needed to be done! We will definitely use them again! Anthony DeLee was friendly and took care of both jobs! Thank you!

Michael did a fantastic job installing a new faucet, valve & shower head for our guest bathroom, and replacing and ancient toilet for us too. He carefully explained what he was going to do, and recommended replacement products with excellent quality and reasonable prices, that were in stock at a local home center. In the meantime, he informed us that our city water service valve would not completely shut off, so we could schedule the city to replace it while he worked around it. Through it all,

We use Sam for all of our plumbing needs, and his service is always top notch! He is very upfront and honest with the repairs needed and the cost. He answers all of my questions and explains anything I dont quite understand. Very courteous and professional when he is in my house and makes a point to clean up any mess from the repairs.

Michael Johnson was very knowledgeable and thorough in diagnosing our plumbing issue.  He was extremely courteous and professional throughout the process.  He fixed our immediate issue and presented long term solutions for us to consider.  Beyond this, we will personally ask for him in the future as plumbing issues arise.

We had an excellent experience with Ernies Plumbing thanks to Austin coming out and installing a new garbage disposal. Austin was very knowledgeable, professional, and friendly! We will be using their services again! Great service!

I had a new washer and dryer delivered from a furniture company. When disconnecting the washer, the cold water valve started leaking and I needed a plumber. I called Ernie’s plumbing on a Friday afternoon, and within an hour, a plumber was on site. The plumber was professional, fixed exactly what needed to be done, and I was incredibly happy with the service provided. Kudos to Robert L. in Arlington, Texas. He did a fantastic job and I am very grateful for the services provided.

I've seen their van quite often in my neighborhood and thought I'd try it. Gary was very pleasant and took care of business quickly. I'll be requesting him on my next plumbing request. Feels good to trust a professional who knows what they are doing and doesn't try to haggle you to pay for more services.

Gary (#483) did a great job replacing our garbage disposal. He was able to arrive quickly within the hour that I called to make an appointment and fixed the problem quickly and efficiently. He is very friendly and answered all of our questions.

The tech from Ernie’s came out his name was Robert he did a fantastic job with fixing our slab leak, also answered any and all of my questions. Will definitely use Ernie’s and request for Robert if needed in the future!
This company was very responsive and professional. We needed them asap on a Saturday. Josh Allison came out and helped us get our toilets working again. My family and I highly recommend this company.

Ernie’s is our go to plumbing company.  They have always done a great job for us.  This time was no exception.  From calling in for the work to the finish of the job I could not ask for an easier process.  Sam took great care of us.  He explained what needed to done .   He stayed in contact with me throughout the process.  He listened to my concerns and addressed them.  I will be requesting him if (when) I need Ernie’s next.   Only wish I could give them better than 5 stars!

Called in the morning for a re-occurring sewer line issue that our snake couldn't handle. Auden came out that afternoon and got us back to functional quickly and ran a camera to determine cause. Auden was professional and friendly throughout and explained the problem thoroughly and gave us options on how to proceed. Gave us a no pressure estimate for replacement for the broken area they had just cleared and also one for complete line replacement, which was much appreciated. Gave information on h

Technicians Robert and Josh came out to my house to install my brand new tankless water heater. (By the way highly recommend having one for a home, absolutely amazing.)  as soon as Robert pointed out that our current water heaters we had were not installed properly by the previous installers he was quick to jump in and resolve the issue professionally and in a timely manner, and they were absolutely awesome. I would recommend Ernies plumbing services to anyone with plumbing issues in their home

We called and they fit us in immediately!  Greg (Employee 188) provided excellent service.  He was thorough and when he discovered the faucet battery pack was not working, made recommendations.  Very detailed in his explanation and pleasant to work with.  Highly Recommend Ernie’s Plumbing Service.

Jonathan and Robert came out and install water heater and did a complete upgrade,  they both did an awesome job, all instruction was explain and clear. Also, work in garage and kitchen done professional. Will use Ernie’s plumbing again. Great job!!

Rob did an excellent job repairing our toilet, and installing a new bathroom faucet. Both now work like they should! He arrived quickly, assessed what needed to be fixed, and finished the job timely. Thank you Ernie’s Plumbing and Rob for a job well done!
